correctness.rationale: The lower bound is the published factor-two theorem for the Lyndon representative (author postprint proof inspected on pages 6–7). The upper bound is a complete 67-row finite certificate. The standalone verifier independently recomputes 67 forward BWTs by sorting all rotations, checks primitive periods, tests unclustered adjacent outputs, and confirms cyclic run counts equal ceiling of half the length. All checks passed. Embedding 0,1,2 in any larger ordered alphabet preserves the BWT and counts.

value.rationale: The same recent paper frames n≥7 equality as a structural extremal conjecture. Sixty-seven consecutive exact sharp values through length 80 (rather than one next integer) form a meaningful contiguous finite cutoff, provide compact replayable examples for all remaining initial lengths, and validate proposed future constructions against a broad edge-case dataset. No infinite theorem is inferred.
